# FILE rows: donor path (donor repository root) -> target path (module root m3/native). PACKAGE rows: donor package -> target package (the package line, mapped imports, and the dotted package name inside string literals and text blocks). TYPE rows: donor type -> target type (M3 naming; identity when the donor name already follows it). DEPENDENCY rows: a simple type of the donor package that is owned by another M3JDK package -> its target FQN; an import is added to every relocated Java file whose code (not comments) names it. EXTERNAL rows: third-party packages the donor imports, kept as they are (declared closure; the pom carries the dependency). JNI rows: JNI symbol and javac -h header prefixes -> target prefixes. TEXT rows: literal donor text -> target text, applied to every line of every file (property names, product names, paths in files without a package line).
